name: PaddleOCR (local worker)
behind_it: PP-OCR models in an isolated interpreter (paddleocr-local)

name: PaddleOCR hosted API
behind_it: adapter written (synthetic data only: the service is outside India); response shape unverified until a key is used

name: Finacle
behind_it: simulators/finacle_sim (in-process); the adapter in front of it is the production code

name: LLM providers (self-hosted and frontier)
behind_it: gateway, redaction, budgets and kill switch are real; no provider is attached, so drafting uses deterministic templates

name: Rules engine, 20 rule packs
behind_it: production code; pack contents are unverified against RBI text

name: Covenant engine, CTS, limits, drawing power, drawdown gate
SMA/ECL, RFA, EWS, calendar, stressed assets, recovery, closure, review
behind_it: production domain services on synthetic input

name: Agents (covenant, EWS, review memo, recovery)
behind_it: real runtime and guards; drafts come from templates because no LLM is attached

name: Model gateway
behind_it: real policy engine with scripted providers in tests

name: EWS and breach models
behind_it: LightGBM trained and evaluated on the synthetic book

name: Postgres / object storage
behind_it: in-memory and SQLite adapters behind ports

name: Kafka / event bus
behind_it: in-process hash-chained event log with idempotent consumers

name: Keys and signing
behind_it: LocalDevKeyProvider (software keys); HSM/KMS provider not built

name: Credit officers, committees, CAD checker, recovery head
behind_it: scripted principals, labelled '(simulated human)' in every timeline

name: GST, Account Aggregator, bureaus, MCA/CERSAI, ratings, news
behind_it: 7 of 14 early-warning indicators have synthetic feeds; the rest are reported as not evaluable

name: Borrower portal and document uploads
behind_it: documents are rendered by the synthetic generator
